idea-plugin.name: RestfulRadar
idea-plugin.description:
RESTful service navigation for IntelliJ IDEA

Jump from a URL path straight to the controller method that serves it. Paste an address copied from a browser, Postman or a log file, and RestfulRadar scans every REST endpoint in your project and takes you to the matching handler.

Features

  • Search by full URL, relative path or bare endpoint path.
  • Input is normalized automatically: protocol, host, port, query string and hash are stripped.
  • Scans Spring MVC / Spring Boot and JAX-RS endpoints.
  • Works with both Java and Kotlin controllers, including Kotlin K2 mode, without relying on fragile Kotlin internal indexes.
  • Filter results by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, ...).
  • Optionally limit the search to the current module.
  • Reuses the text selected in the editor or the URL in the clipboard as the initial query.
  • Choose a modal dialog or a right-side tool window as the default search UI.

How to use

  1. Press Ctrl+Alt+/, or run Go to REST Service from Find Action.
  2. Paste or type the request address, for example /api/users/42 or https://example.com/api/users/42?active=true.
  3. Optionally pick an HTTP method and tick Current module.
  4. Press Enter or click a result to open the matching controller method.

Path variables are supported, for example /users/{id} or /orders/{orderId:\d+}.

Actions and shortcuts

  • Go to REST Service - Ctrl+Alt+/, opens the search UI configured in the settings.
  • Switch REST Search UI - Ctrl+Alt+Shift+/, toggles the preferred search UI.
  • Go to REST Service (Dialog) and Go to REST Service (Popup) - always open the fixed UI; no default shortcut, bind your own under Settings | Keymap.
  • Rescan REST Mappings - clear the cache and scan the project again.
  • All actions are also available under Tools | RestfulRadar.

Settings

Under Settings | Tools | RestfulRadar you can choose the window opened by Ctrl+Alt+/ (dialog or right-side tool window) and the maximum number of results shown in the list.

Compatibility

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 (build 243) and later, up to 2026.3.
  • Uses the bundled Java, Kotlin, YAML and Properties plugins.
  • No runtime dependency on Spring or JAX-RS libraries.

License

Apache License 2.0. Source code and issue tracker: github.com/XiShanRain/QuickRestfulToolkit
